SELECT s.* FROM t_media_series s LEFT JOIN t_media_metadata m ON m.id = s.metadata_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId}
AND ( s.series_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.title ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.original_title ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.overview ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY m.release_date ASC NULLS LAST, s.id ORDER BY m.release_date DESC NULLS LAST, s.id
ORDER BY s.min_file_last_modified ASC NULLS LAST, s.id ORDER BY s.min_file_last_modified DESC NULLS LAST, s.id
